display_name: The Income Tax Act 1947 under one top-level goal — how much income tax a person owes for a year of assessment, and by when — and ten goals: residence, the charge, exemptions, deductions and allowances, statutory to chargeable income and reliefs, rates rebates and credits, withholding, filing and disputes, payment, offences
scope: Every section of the Act as printed in SSO's PDF, current version as at 06 Oct 2026 (2020 Revised Edition with later amendments to Act 17 of 2026), given a disposition in NOTES.md: 114 encoded, 111 inputs (approval-based regimes and special ascertainment rules whose result enters the computation as a figure), 92 inert, 26 out of the encoded period, 11 repealed; and the twelve Schedules. The computation is stated for YA 2024 onwards; earlier YAs refuse, the Second Schedule's printed tables answering for every YA from 2012. NOT encoded: the MMT Act's DTT and MTT (a separate Act); subsidiary legislation (prescribed figures are inputs).

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the Act. An independent test pass was run on 2026-10-06 (tests-independent.l4; expectations written from the source before the encoding was read, in independent-expectations.md); it found four encoding errors (ss 10L(2)(b), 13(1)(jd), 43X(5)), all fixed; triage in INDEPENDENT-TEST-REPORT.md and NOTES.md section 8. The source is SSO's unofficial consolidation. The pipeline has not been run.

forks.I1: The computation refuses YAs before 2024; printed YA tables still answer.
forks.I2: ss 40B(3), 40C(3): the resident comparison is resident rates on chargeable income less a resident's reliefs, apportioned to the employment share.
forks.I3: s 39(1): the age band reached by 31 December of the preceding year; (b) added to (c) or (d).
forks.I4: s 39(2)(h), (ha): the printed 37% and $37,740, not prescribed alternatives.
forks.I5: s 10(2)(cb)(i): the employee's rent is not deducted from employer-paid rent.
forks.I6: s 45(4)(b): completed months from 30 days after the due date.
forks.I7: s 87(1): 5% the day after the last day; 1% months from 60 days after; amount constant.
forks.I8: s 62(4): the 3-month period ends on 31 March; notice by 14 April.
forks.I9: Fifth Schedule para 5(1AB)(c) 'the eligible child' read as the first eligible child.
